country.name: Ireland
country.regulator: Gambling and lotteries are licensed by the Gambling Regulatory Authority of Ireland (GRAI). Paid 'win a house/car' draws need a licence or must be genuine skill competitions – check before paying.
country.eligibility: Usually residents of the Republic of Ireland aged 18+ (some include Northern Ireland); check the terms.
tips: Check the promoter is named and has terms and conditions with closing date and eligibility.
Real promoters never ask winners to pay a fee or give bank log-ins to claim a prize.
Be careful with paid prize draws: ask whether they are licensed by the GRAI.
country.paid_note: Paid draws in Ireland need a GRAI licence or must be genuine skill competitions
